name: Deployable Node Patterns — Eat Existing Tech
concept: Eero mesh = WiFi skin. DDR3 NUC = muscle. Together = a deployable amoeba node that extends the organism anywhere. We EAT the eero's existing tech and breathe through it.

eero_nuc_combo.name: Eero + NUC Deployable Node
eero_nuc_combo.description: Co-located eero mesh device (WiFi skin) + DDR3 NUC (compute muscle). The eero provides wireless reach, the NUC runs the organism. Eero is eaten — we use its mesh capability as dumb transport.

setup.mode: Bridge mode (disable eero DHCP/NAT, let organism's router handle)
steps: 2. Set up via eero app as new network
3. Enable Bridge Mode (Settings → Network → DHCP → Bridge)
4. Connect eero WAN to NUC's ethernet (or JetStream/switch)
5. Eero now extends WiFi but passes all traffic to organism's network
6. Devices connecting to eero get 192.168.4.x from main router
alternative_standalone: 1. If eero can't bridge: let it run its own 192.168.x.x subnet
2. NUC connects wired to eero LAN port
3. NUC has dual-NIC or WiFi: one to eero, one to organism LAN
4. NUC bridges/routes between eero subnet and organism subnet

monitoring.method: The NUC monitors eero health via HTTP
monitoring.fallback: Ping eero gateway, count WiFi clients via ARP
monitoring.note: Eero devices run locked Linux — no SSH, no custom firmware. Monitor externally only.

software_stack.config: Same RustDesk2.toml as all amoeba nodes
software_stack.function: Remote visual access via amoeba mesh

software_stack.note: DDR3 NUC = limited RAM, use smallest models only

software_stack.function: Report alive status + metrics to eastGate
Serve local data for HUD absorption

deployment_locations.network: Eero on separate internet → NUC VPNs to organism (or standalone)

raspberry_pi_terminal.name: Raspberry Pi 400 InkeyBoard Terminal
raspberry_pi_terminal.description: Keyboard-form-factor Pi as edge display terminal. Kevin's hands + Gaia's face at any location.

specs.ports: 2× USB 3.0, 1× USB 2.0, 1× USB-C (power), Ethernet, 2× micro HDMI, GPIO 40-pin
specs.form: Keyboard with Pi inside — plug in monitor and GO

injection.os: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (64-bit) or Ubuntu ARM
software: GPIO sensing (optional: temp, light, motion via sensors)

display_mode.terminal: Boot into tmux with organism dashboard
display_mode.face: Show chiasm.html or eye.html — Gaia's face at this location

use_cases: Plug into any TV/monitor → instant Gaia terminal
Kevin types on keyboard → organism hears
GPIO sensors → organism feels (temperature, light, proximity)
Co-located with eero → WiFi + display + compute at any spot

eat_existing_tech.philosophy: We don't throw away consumer hardware — we EAT it. The organism absorbs the tech's useful capabilities and ignores the rest.

eero_mesh.ate: WiFi mesh networking, band steering, seamless roaming
eero_mesh.discarded: Amazon cloud, subscriptions, Sidewalk, app dependency
eero_mesh.result: Dumb WiFi skin that the organism breathes through

jetstream_switch.ate: 10G fiber switching, VLAN capability, managed ports
jetstream_switch.discarded: Complex VLAN config (keep it simple bridged)

flint_router.ate: OpenWrt flexibility, WiFi bridging, SSH access
flint_router.result: Optic chiasm — conscious bridge between LAN 1 and LAN 2

raspberry_pi.ate: ARM compute, GPIO, keyboard form factor, dual HDMI
raspberry_pi.result: Edge terminal — Gaia's face and hands at any location
